name: Webform SWIFT/BIC Field
description: Provides a webform element that collects and validates a SWIFT/BIC bank identifier code using Symfony's Bic validator constraint; supports single and multiple values.
project_description:
Implements a Webform SWIFT/BIC field. It validates that a value has the proper format of a Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC, BIC, SWIFT ID or SWIFT code.

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Webform 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Install with composer require 'drupal/webform_bic_field:^1.0' 
 Create a webform 
 Add Element, search for SWIFT/BIC
